test_title: PYST 8: Selection Post (Matric Level) - GA (Held On 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the main purpose of the 'INSPIRE' programme by the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Promote science education**__.

**__Key Points__**

• The **INSPIRE** (Innovation in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research) programme is a flagship scheme of the **Government of India**, managed by the **Department of Science and Technology (DST)** under the **Ministry of Science and Technology**.

• The primary objective of the programme is to **promote science education** and attract young talent to the study of **Basic and Natural Sciences** at an early age. ***Hence, statement 1 is correct.***

• It aims to build the required critical human resource pool for strengthening and expanding the **Science and Technology (S&T)** system and **Research and Development (R&D)** base in the country.

• The scheme does not involve the **development of nuclear reactors**, which is the mandate of the **Department of Atomic Energy (DAE)**. ***Hence, statement 2 is incorrect.***
